name: Click Assist
description: Shows how many frames early or late your clicks are, and optionally helps with input buffering and coyote time. Assist mod, do not use for leaderboard records.

assist.name: Assist
assist.description: Buffer early clicks and allow late clicks. Turn off to only get timing notifications.

notify.name: Timing Notifications
notify.description: Show 'Too early' and 'Too late' notifications with the frame count.

buffer-ms.name: Input Buffer (ms)
buffer-ms.description: An early click made in the air within this time jumps automatically when you land.

coyote-ms.name: Coyote Time (ms)
coyote-ms.description: A late click within this time after leaving the ground still jumps.

frame-rate.name: Frame Rate For Display
frame-rate.description: Frames are calculated as time multiplied by this value (60 = normal game frames, 240 = physics steps).
